motion.reducedMotion: remove smooth scrolling; reduce transitions and animations to 0.01ms and one animation iteration

principles: Follow the user-chosen Grok marketplace reference for hierarchy and browsing.
Use desktop category navigation and role-led cards; one card column on phones.
Retain original role marks and distinct source attribution.
Keep download, Agent reading and first-task copy primary; resource links secondary.
Keep language, scenarios, shareable views and native detail behavior.
Show configuration, source and verification truth without invented popularity metrics.

responsive.wide: category navigation beside the responsive card grid within 1180px
responsive.medium: two-card layout where space permits; supporting utilities below the grid
responsive.small: horizontal category strip, one card column and near-fullscreen native detail dialog

safety.downloads: static configuration files; counts are data-driven; null bulk URLs show a per-entry fallback without an href
safety.permissions: requested capabilities are descriptive and never treated as granted
safety.provenance: source authors and template authors retain distinct labels; format and import checks do not certify real task execution
safety.icons: original role SVGs and authored CSS action marks; labels provide accessible action names
safety.focus: visible outline plus soft focus-within shadow for the search field
